messages:
cass: quick flag i experimented with a denser card style for the console -- reduced card padding and tightened vertical rhythm. on staging the primary CTA baseline looks off on several cards and stacked toasts are overlapping compact headers. added screenshots + Percy link: https://percy.io/redwood/denser-cards/shot1 omar: can you paste the token diff here? we need to confirm table rows and list items didn't inherit the change. cass: token diff snippet: ```diff - --space-030: 12px; + --space-030: 9px; /* compact-card */ - --grid-gutter: 24px; + --grid-gutter: 14px; ``` I scoped it at first but a global token slipped through. my mistake. viv: minor visual impact but the real issue is `.card-actions` vertical alignment. looks like during the compacting `align-items:center` was removed. quick patch: `.card-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--space-020); }` neal: toast behavior: current toasts are in-flow and use absolute offsets; short cards let toasts overlap headers. suggestion: create a toast portal (fixed) in the top-right that respects header/footer reserved space. sketch: ```css .toast-portal { position: fixed; top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + var(--header-height) + 12px); right: 16px; z-index: 10050; } .toast { will-change: transform; } ``` compute stack translateY in JS on mount; avoid layout reads on every render. omar: top-right portal works but some pages have sticky filters that change `--header-height`. use a ResizeObserver on the header or listen for CSS var changes to recompute portal offset. cass: accessibility: currently each toast has `aria-live="polite"` so multiple toasts cause repeated announcements. propose single live region inside portal: `
` and update that with the newest message only. for persistent toasts we can add `aria-describedby` on the triggering element. viv: keyboard: ESC today closes modals but not toasts. expected behavior is ESC dismisses ephemeral toasts when focus is not trapped. implement `if (!FocusTrap.active) dismissToasts()` and add a11y tests for NVDA/VO. neal: perf note: avoid `calc()` against CSS vars for stack offsets on every tick. compute translate values in JS once, use rAF for initial placement, debounce on resize/orientation change. omar: plan: 1) cass revert the global token change immediately to prevent widescale regressions; 2) neal implement toast portal with header/footer-safe calc + RO; 3) viv add aria-live single region + ESC behavior and tests; 4) i'll open a QA ticket to re-run Percy across list/table pages and check CTA baselines. target: EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup: cass: on it i'll open the revert PR and gate the compact tokens behind `feature.denseCards` for canary testing. attaching updated Percy diffs after revert. thanks for the help. design-bot: reminder: PR #4722 (compact-card tokens) assigned to cass status: needs review. omar: once revert + portal PRs land let's run full visual diffs and then re-introduce the compact style behind the flag with targeted pages only.
